snippet.title: Endurance Motorsport Series | Galeao Track Trailer
snippet.description:
Galeao is a fictional track created with the help of professional GT3, LMP2 and LMPH drivers in the country of Brazil!

See the Developer Interview on Steam now to go behind the scenes on how level designers and environmental artists create our fictional tracks!
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2228250/view/688631008673661323

Releasing 2026, Endurance Motorsport Series provides unique gameplay in which the way you adapt your decisions and race strategy to events (incidents, weather, etc) is just as important as your driving skills. You will have to find the best balance between speed and consistency in your search for victory.

Learn more here! https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2228250/view/525368550330728459

In addition to the genuine challenge posed by the duration of the races, one of the prominent features of endurance racing is that it is multi-class. You progress through a selection of the best Hypercars, LMP2 and GT from the major car manufacturers.
